changelog:
- Initial release with support for converting PDF files to PPTX (PowerPoint) and DOCX (Word) formats.
- Each PDF page is converted to an individual PPTX slide with embedded images.
- DOCX output preserves text and image structure for editing.
- Includes file size control with automatic compression to meet specified limits.
- Supports batch conversion of directories and options to adjust image quality and DPI.
- Provides detailed command-line usage and troubleshooting guidance.
summary: Convert PDFs to PPTX slides or editable DOCX files with configurable image quality, DPI, file size limit, and batch processing support.
